document.title: Distributions From ABLE Accounts

boxes.label: CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.notes: Marks this statement as correcting one already furnished for the same year.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: Printed on Copy A only; a filer's mark, never a figure.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.notes: The filer's own account number; identification only.

boxes.label: Basis
boxes.notes: Basis in the box 1 gross distribution.

boxes.label: Check if ABLE account terminated in the calendar year reported
If this box is checked, the recipient is not the designated beneficiary

document.notes: Box 1 = box 2 + box 3. Only the earnings can be taxable, and only to the extent the distribution was not used for qualified disability expenses or rolled over; the taxable amount is Schedule 1 line 8q. Additional tax is figured on Form 5329.

extraction.note: No structured model is bound: no Azure prebuilt-tax model for this form is recorded anywhere in this repo (schema, notes or the 068 model re-verification), and a model name is never guessed. The page is read by the generic reader.
